Chapter 1001 15: Xuan Huang's Precious Treasure (Subscription Request)

"Yan, was that the Qingfen Grand Sovereign just now?"

"The Qingfen Grand Sovereign... what did the Grand Sovereign say to you?"

Within the Yu Family, Yu Chaolong finally regained his senses after a long pause and couldn't help but ask.

Not only Yu Chaolong, but several of the elders of the Yu Family felt the same.

Even now, they were still immersed in the shock of Lord Qingfen's personal arrival.

Everyone only saw the Qingfen Grand Sovereign exchange a few words with Lin Yuan, who responded briefly, but what was said remained an enigma.

Lord Qingfen's aura was simply too terrifying.

On top of that, the conversation was deliberately shielded.

The entire Yu Family had no idea about the exchange between Lord Qingfen and Lin Yuan.

"The Grand Sovereign said he wanted to take me as his disciple."

Lin Yuan did not conceal the matter, stating it outright.

These words were spoken.

The elders of the Yu Family instantly drew in deep breaths.

Even with the mental fortitude of Self-Dao Realm cultivators, tumultuous waves surged within them at this moment.

It wasn't uncommon for Lord Qingfen to take disciples—various Qing Envoys traveling across the Qingfen Domain would periodically bring batches of geniuses to pledge themselves to Lord Qingfen.

Most of these geniuses possessed Nine Suns aptitude, while a small number had condensed Ten Suns.

Since the Qingfen Grand Sovereign took charge of the Qingfen Domain, taking disciples had been routine.

However, the process of accepting disciples...

was for the Qing Envoys to escort the individuals back to Qingfen City, where the Grand Sovereign would inspect them before formally accepting them.

But now?

The Qingfen Grand Sovereign had traveled untold millions of miles from the distant Qingfen City to personally take Lin Yuan as his disciple?

Such an event had never occurred since the Qingfen Grand Sovereign assumed control over the Qingfen Domain.

Even the strongest disciple under the Grand Sovereign's command, Feng Wanxing, who had condensed over seven hundred Sunfire Seeds before the age of five hundred, had never received such treatment.

"Yan..."

The elders of the Yu Family exchanged glances. If they hadn't witnessed it themselves, they would never have believed the Qingfen Grand Sovereign would act in this manner.

At the Grand Sovereign's level, the so-called act of taking disciples was merely fulfilling the duties of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

After all, even if he accepted millions of disciples, it was highly unlikely that any would reach the heights where they could stand shoulder to shoulder with the Grand Sovereign.

"What exactly is happening..." Several Yu Family elders hesitated, not daring to probe too deeply, as Yu Chaolong finally voiced the question.

Indeed.

What was happening?

Why did the exalted Qingfen Grand Sovereign suddenly descend?

Why did he abruptly accept Lin Yuan as his disciple?

Just moments ago, the upper echelons of the Yu Family had been pondering how to preserve the hope of their lineage amidst the rising dominance of the Dongyang Clan.

"Perhaps it's because I condensed slightly more Sunfire Seeds." Lin Yuan explained.

In truth, this was the sole reason. The "Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method" was a secret technique personally propagated by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

The Sunfire Seeds condensed through its use held unimaginable power for understanding the principles of the Dao and even facilitating physical transformation.

Lin Yuan had condensed over ten thousand Sunfire Seeds. Within this Fierce Sun Ancient Country, such an accomplishment, while not entirely unprecedented, was something that hadn't appeared in countless eons.

"Slightly more Sunfire Seeds?"

The elders of the Yu Family deliberated on these words.

Yu Chaolong similarly pondered the implications of this statement.

"Yan." Yuchi Ling looked at Lin Yuan.

As his mother, she faintly realized what was about to happen next.

"Lord Qingfen asked me to prepare; he'll take me away shortly."

Lin Yuan said.

In truth, there wasn't much to prepare—a brief farewell to the members of the Yu Family was all that was needed.

"Good, good, good."

The elders of the Yu Family finally regained their composure, their spirits rejuvenated as they gazed at Lin Yuan fervently.

After the initial shock, fear, and incredulity faded, they began to contemplate what Lord Qingfen's personal arrival to accept Lin Yuan as his disciple truly represented.

...

Half an hour later.

Lord Qingfen's figure reappeared.

In truth, Lord Qingfen had never left. He had been observing the Yu Family from the depths of space-time—more precisely, observing Lin Yuan.

The most terrifying aspect of Lin Yuan wasn't that he had condensed over ten thousand Sunfire Seeds before the age of five hundred.

It was that during this entire process, he had done it entirely on his own, without any guidance whatsoever.

Even the act of condensing Sunfire Seeds involved numerous tricks and shortcuts to significantly reduce the difficulty.

Feng Wanxing, the Grand Sovereign's top disciple, had only condensed a little over one hundred Sunfire Seeds when he first joined the Qingfen Grand Sovereign.

Eventually, with guidance from the Grand Sovereign, he was able to condense more than seven hundred Sunfire Seeds before the age of five hundred.

Lin Yuan, on the other hand, had yet to receive a single ounce of guidance. It could be easily predicted that, upon joining Lord Qingfen's tutelage and gaining relevant guidance, the number of Sunfire Seeds he would condense before age five hundred would surely surge dramatically.

Condensing over ten thousand Sunfire Seeds before the age of five hundred was already an unbelievable accomplishment.

As for achieving more?

Lord Qingfen himself was beginning to anticipate it.

"Are you ready?" Lord Qingfen's tone was gentle.

When interacting with others, Lord Qingfen was overwhelmingly aloof—even with his disciples.

But with Lin Yuan? He found it impossible to maintain that cold demeanor.

"I'm ready."

Lin Yuan nodded.

The members of the Yu Family were equally stirred with excitement.

At that moment.

Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!

Three figures suddenly arrived.

It was You Jue, Shi Song, and the other Qing Envoys in their tall and imposing forms.

Earlier, during Lin Yuan's farewells to his parents, the three Qing Envoys had also stepped aside.

"Marquis."

You Jue bowed to Lord Qingfen and spoke in a low voice, "We are aware that the Dongyang Clan has previously been harmful to the Yu Family and even targeted Yu Yan for assassination."

Before his voice fell.

You Jue flipped his right hand, and hundreds of figures instantly materialized—it was the elders, the clan leader, and the high-ranking members of the Dongyang Clan. Even the once-revered Dongyang Meng was among them.

At that moment, all members of the Dongyang Clan were prostrated on the ground, completely stunned without the slightest understanding of what was transpiring.
